items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: I have autographed pictures of Johnny Long, Joe Reichman, Paul Neighbors, all those bands, all those band leaders and everything in the different acts.

ctx.x: I don't know. And the Blue Room, five years as an act, a jazz band, as long as five months at a time. And it broke all records for any bands being there. Because in those days, there were name bands that only came there and played one month at a time. Four weeks at a time. We were with, let me see, five months at one stretch, we were with five different bands. I have autographed pictures of Johnny Long, Joe Reichman, Paul Neighbors, all those bands, all those band leaders and everything in the different acts. But…
When you all played in the Blue Room, was that at the time when the Blue Room was broadcast on the radio?
